The Tome of Strahd.Name: Torturer
The Tome of Strahd.Reading: There is a town where all is not well. There you will find a house of corruption, and within, a dark room full of still ghosts.
The Tome of Strahd.Meaning: The treasure is hidden in the attic of the burgomaster's mansion in Vallaki.

The Holy Symbol of Ravenkind.Name: Miser
The Holy Symbol of Ravenkind.Reading: Look for a fortress inside a fortress, in a place hidden behind fire.
The Holy Symbol of Ravenkind.Meaning: The treasure lies in Castle Ravenloft's treasury.

The Sunsword.Name: Druid
The Sunsword.Reading: An evil tree grows atop a hill of graves where the ancient dead sleep. The ravens can help you find it. Look for the treasure there.
The Sunsword.Meaning: The treasure lies at the base of the Gulthias Tree. Any wereraven encountered in the wilderness can lead the characters to the location.

Strahd's Enemy.Name: Ghost
Strahd's Enemy.Reading: I see a fallen paladin of a fallen order of knights. He lingers like a ghost in a dead dragon's lair.
Strahd's Enemy.Meaning: This card refers to the revenant Sir Godfrey Gwilym. Although initially unwilling to accompany the characters, he will do so if the characters convince him that the honor of the Order of the Silver Dragon can be restored with his help. Doing this requires a successful DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check.

Strahd's Location in the Castle.Name: Horseman
Strahd's Location in the Castle.Reading: He lurks in the one place to which he must return—a place of death.
Strahd's Location in the Castle.Meaning: Strahd faces the characters in his tomb.
